# System packages required to build / run a host Python for diagnostic-agent.
#
# Amazon Linux 2 ships Python 3.7 and OpenSSL 1.0.2. Python >=3.11 (required by
# this project) needs OpenSSL 1.1.1+ for the `_ssl` module. Install these before
# `pyenv install 3.12` or any from-source Python build.
#
# Usage:
#   sudo yum install -y $(grep -v '^#' deps/amazon-linux-2.txt | tr '\n' ' ')
#
# Or: ./scripts/install-system-deps.sh

git
curl
gcc
make
patch
bzip2-devel
libffi-devel
readline-devel
sqlite-devel
zlib-devel
xz-devel
# OpenSSL 1.1.1 (AL2 default openssl-devel is 1.0.2 and breaks Python 3.12 _ssl)
openssl11
openssl11-devel
# Useful when the agent runs under Docker Compose on the same host
docker
